req.title: Retrieve task by id
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /tasks/{task_id} with the corresponding task object.

doc.reasoning: The violation was test[6] having kind=negative but heuristic=STC. STC (State Transition Coverage) is only valid for positive or boundary kinds that exercise state changes. The fix is to change test[6] heuristic from STC to NEG, which is the correct heuristic for a negative test that verifies a deleted resource returns 404. All other tests are preserved exactly as they were.

tests.name: test_retrieve_existing_task_returns_200_with_exact_fields
preconditions: A task is created via POST /tasks/ to obtain a known id
actions: POST /tasks/ with title='Buy milk', description='2 litres', completed=false
GET /tasks/{task_id} using the id returned by POST
expected: Response body contains id matching created task
tests.executable:
import os
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite:///./test_r008_pos.db')
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import engine
from app import models
models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
client = TestClient(app)

def test_retrieve_existing_task_returns_200_with_exact_fields():
    post_r = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Buy milk', 'description': '2 litres', 'completed': False})
    assert post_r.status_code == 201
    task_id = post_r.json()['id']
    r = client.get(f'/tasks/{task_id}')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == task_id
    assert body['title'] == 'Buy milk'
    assert body['description'] == '2 litres'
    assert body['completed'] == False
    assert body['created_at'] is not None

test_retrieve_existing_task_returns_200_with_exact_fields()

tests.name: test_retrieve_deleted_task_returns_404
preconditions: A task is created then deleted
expected: detail message contains the deleted task id
tests.executable:
import os
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite:///./test_r008_neg_del.db')
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import engine
from app import models
models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
client = TestClient(app)

def test_retrieve_deleted_task_returns_404():
    post_r = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Temporary task', 'completed': False})
    assert post_r.status_code == 201
    task_id = post_r.json()['id']
    del_r = client.delete(f'/tasks/{task_id}')
    assert del_r.status_code in (200, 204)
    r = client.get(f'/tasks/{task_id}')
    assert r.status_code == 404
    body = r.json()
    assert str(task_id) in body['detail']

test_retrieve_deleted_task_returns_404()
